periods.text: RCFC 6(a)(1)(B): count {n} calendar day(s) {after} the trigger, including weekends/holidays -> {date}
court days: advance {n} business day(s) {forward} from {trigger} (skipping weekends/holidays) -> {date}

forward.text: RCFC 6(a)(1)(C): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: RCFC 6(a)(5): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.text: RCFC 6(d)/(c): service by {method} adds {days} day(s) (after the period expires under the counting rule) -> {date}
steps.backwardText: RCFC 6(d)/(c) does not apply to backward-counted periods; ignored

forward.text: RCFC 6(a)(1)(C): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll forward -> {date}

backward.text: RCFC 6(a)(5): last day fell on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; roll backward -> {date}

steps.text: RCFC 6(a)(3): clerk's office inaccessible on the last day; extend -> {date}
steps.ignoredText: clerk_inaccessible requested but RCFC 6 has no applicable clerk-inaccessibility extension for this direction; ignored

hours.text: RCFC 6(a)(2)(A): begin counting immediately (the trigger hour counts); +{n} hour(s)
hours.rollText: RCFC 6(a)(2)(C): period would end on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday; continue to the same time on {date}

months.text: RCFC 6: count {n} {unit} {after} the anchor to the corresponding day, else the last day of that month -> {date}
